headline: RapWire 24/7: Five distinct stories — Sept. 24, 2026 — 8 AM Pacific
body: This verified five-slide RapWire news carousel covers five distinct current stories: G-Eazy’s EZMNY–EMPIRE partnership; 50 Cent’s Headcrack casino game; Jay-Z’s HBO documentary revelations; Take-Two’s GTA 6 PC comments; and Rihanna joining A$AP Rocky in Copenhagen. Each story is separately sourced, visually identified, and labeled with context and attribution.

caption:
#RapWire247 — five distinct stories for Sept. 24, 2026.
1) G-Eazy has left the major-label system for a joint partnership with Ty Dolla Sign’s EZMNY Records and EMPIRE, with a new “JFK” collaboration due Friday.
Sources: https://www.complex.com/music/a/will-lavin/g-eazy-ezmny-records-empire-partnership-ty-dolla-sign | https://www.linkedin.com/company/empire/
Handles: @G_Eazy · @tydollasign · @EMPIRE
2) 50 Cent and TCSJOHNHUXLEY are bringing Headcrack, a live casino adaptation of the street dice game Cee-Lo, to G2E Las Vegas.
Sources: https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/from-the-corner-to-the-casino-floor-curtis-50-cent-jackson-and-tcsjohnhuxley-bring-50-cent-headcrack-to-g2e-las-vegas-2026-302885554.html | https://www.casino.com/news/las-vegas/50-cent-unveils-head-crack-dice-game-ahead-of-g2e-debut/
Handles: @50Cent · @TCSJOHNHUXLEY
3) Jay-Z’s HBO docuseries with Rick Rubin revisits the moment he nearly walked away from rap after his debut album.
Sources: https://24hip-hop.com/jay-z-in-8-hbo-docuseries-rick-rubin/ | https://au.variety.com/2026/music/news/jay-z-documentary-series-rick-rubin-hbo-jay-z-in-8-38019/
Handles: @sc · @HBO · @RocNation
4) Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick said PC is becoming “more and more important” while GTA 6 still has no announced PC version.
Sources: https://www.pcgamer.com/games/grand-theft-auto/the-pc-platform-is-becoming-more-and-more-important-take-two-chief-says-as-we-continue-to-wonder-when-were-going-to-get-gta-6/ | https://www.gamesradar.com/games/grand-theft-auto/gta-6-on-pc-sounds-more-inevitable-than-ever-thanks-to-take-two-ceos-latest-comments/
Handles: @RockstarGames · @TakeTwo
5) Rihanna joined A$AP Rocky onstage at Copenhagen’s Royal Arena, with their son Riot Rose also appearing during “Lord Pretty Flacko Jodye 2.”
Sources: https://www.complex.com/music/a/treyalston/asap-rocky-rihanna-riot-copenhagen-tour | https://billboard.com.br/rihanna-filho-palco-asap-rocky-copenhague/
Handles: @asaprocky · @rihanna

@Rapwire247
